programme.title: Kanave Kalayadhe
programme.desc: Just as everything was falling into place for Anand, he is distraught when the girl he loves dies in a blast. Fate plays yet another trick on him when he finds himself face to face with her lookalike.

programme.title: Vaalee
programme.desc: Deva, a man with a hearing and speech impairment, secretly loves his twin brother's wife, Priya. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

programme.title: Vaigai

programme.title: Vaikarai Pookkal

programme.desc: Newlyweds Malli and Chitra get stranded in a flood and start sharing their life stories to evade fear. Just as both realise how much they care for one another, the situation starts to get worse.

programme.title: Kaadhalan
programme.desc: Prabhu, a college student, falls in love with Shruthi, a governor's daughter. On knowing about their love affair, her father imprisons Prabhu and forbids him to meet Shruthi.

programme.title: Thirunelveli

programme.desc: Yama attempts to save an innocent child and accidentally rescues a corrupt politician along with her. Lord Shiva, who is furious about Yama's mistake, gives him an ultimatum to amend the situation.

programme.title: Ivan
programme.desc: Jeevan wants to fight against the injustice in society. After losing his father to anti-social elements and knowing that he cannot fight alone, he approaches the cause differently.

programme.title: Sengottai
